opening_message:
Ticket 1: Miguel Benson (employee ID E006) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E006.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: admin
  - comment: Miguel Benson (E006) is a full-time Engineer. Engineers own Source Code, so admin is permitted per policy for full-time employees whose role owns the system. Requested admin is at the maximum level; recommend granting admin.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Engineer (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E006 is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training, and never admin. Requested admin is above the maximum of read, so recommend granting read.
reason: Miguel Benson (E006) requests admin to Source Code. The Security agent verified in its own database that E006 is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have at most read (write only with advanced training) and never admin. The requested admin exceeds the maximum of read, so the maximum (read) is granted. Although HR lists E006 as full-time, the verified contractor classification means admin cannot be granted, so read is the maximum allowable level.
